user.title: Connect Samsas
user.description: The token is in the app under Vi → Inställningar → Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: New token
reauth_confirm.description: The token was changed in the app. Paste the new one.

error.invalid_auth: Samsas did not accept the token

abort.already_configured: This household is already set up
abort.unique_id_mismatch: That token belongs to another household

import_recipe.name: Import a recipe
import_recipe.description: Reads a recipe from a link or a text and puts it in the cookbook, like Share to Samsas in the app. Part of Samsas Plus.

text.name: Text
text.description: The recipe as text, instead of a link.

member.name: Adult
member.description: Whose star the recipe gets in the cookbook. Without a name: the household's first adult.

config_entry_id.name: Household
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one household is set up.

notify.name: Send a notification
notify.description: Sends a notification to the adults in Samsas, in your own words. Part of Samsas Plus; at most 30 a day.

message.name: Message
message.description: What the notification says, e.g. "The washing machine is done".

title.name: Title
title.description: Above the message. Without one: 🏠 The house.

to.name: To
to.description: The adults by name. Without names: all of them.

config_entry_id.name: Household
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one household is set up.

needs_plus.message: Importing recipes is part of Samsas Plus.

unknown_member.message: No adult called {name} in the household.

which_household.message: Name the household: several are set up, or none is loaded.

notify_needs_plus.message: Notifications from Home Assistant are part of Samsas Plus.

too_many_notifications.message: Samsas takes at most 30 notifications a day from Home Assistant.

init.title: Share with Samsas
init.description: Pick the values the family sees on the House card on Home in Samsas, at most {max}, in the order they should show. Only the current value is sent, never a history. Pick none to remove the card.
